description: Starts a text-to-image or image-to-image job for the signed-in user. When to use: after estimate_cost with the same arguments. Cost: debits up to max_credits when queued (same pricing as web). Returns: generation_id and next steps (poll with check_generation). Uses credits immediately when accepted. Prefer reference_generation_ids or reference_upload_ids for Vidaro-owned images; external URLs also count toward model max references.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio when the model supports it.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

max_credits.description: Ceiling credits the user agreed to spend; must be >= estimate_cost result.
max_credits.title: Max Credits

prompt.description: User prompt text; must not be empty for text_to_image.
prompt.title: Prompt

reference_generation_ids.description: image_to_image: past Vidaro image generation ids to use as refs.
reference_generation_ids.title: Reference Generation Ids

reference_upload_ids.description: image_to_image: upload library ids as refs.
reference_upload_ids.title: Reference Upload Ids

style_id.description: Soul-style id when the model uses styles.
style_id.title: Style Id

name: generate_image
title: Generate image
